fit_summary: A strong fit on the core of this role: Mat builds LLM-powered automations that act on real systems (CRM, calendars, email) and runs them in production himself. The main gap is Kubernetes, a nice-to-have; his container experience is Docker and Compose.

matches.requirement: 3+ years building production systems; TypeScript or Python
matches.evidence: Six years running production IT at a SaaS company, plus shipped apps in TypeScript (Forge server, this site's agent) and Python (Tally, FastAPI, about 318 tests).

matches.requirement: LLM APIs, tool use and agent patterns
matches.evidence: Claude API and Claude Code agents with tools and hooks; Agentic Builder, a 19-agent Claude Code plugin; the tool-using agent on this site.
About 140 n8n workflows in queue mode for AGP: tenant onboarding, a campaign dispatcher with a queue, and a shared tenant-resolution subflow.

matches.requirement: Integrations with CRM, email and internal APIs
matches.evidence: AI receptionist synced to GoHighLevel CRM and calendars; webhooks and third-party API integrations across the AGP platform.
36 Docker Compose services run as code with digest-pinned images and a validated deploy gate; GitHub Actions CI on Tally and Forge.
Prometheus and alerting across the homelab; PRTG monitoring at Cority; per-call logging and cost dashboards for AGP.

matches.requirement: Voice AI or telephony (nice to have)
matches.evidence: Built and operates an AI phone receptionist on Vapi, live with 5 clients.

matches.requirement: Evals for LLM features (nice to have)
matches.evidence: Prompt and eval design is listed in his skills, but the profile doesn't describe a specific eval suite.

gaps.note: Not in his profile. His orchestration experience is Docker Compose at a 36-service scale, with policy-gated deploys.

headline: AI automation engineer who ships agents into production
summary: Builds LLM-powered automations that act on real business systems, and runs them in production. Founder of an AI voice and automation platform live with 5 clients (about 140 n8n workflows, Vapi, CRM sync), with six years of production systems administration behind it.

bullets: Built about 140 n8n workflows automating operations for local businesses: multi-tenant onboarding and provisioning, an outbound campaign dispatcher with a queue, social autopilot, and cost dashboards.
Designed and operate an AI voice receptionist on Vapi, integrated with GoHighLevel CRM and calendars, live with 5 clients.
Shipped a Lead-Leak Audit pipeline: intake, enrichment and scoring, Claude-structured research, and AI-generated preview websites (Next.js, Postgres).
Run the production stack: Docker, Traefik, Postgres, Redis, and queue-mode n8n with workers.
Ran IT for a mid-sized SaaS company across two offices, a data center and remote staff.
Built, patched and troubleshot physical and virtual Windows and Linux servers (VMware ESXi, iDRAC).
Owned backups, licensing and vendor coordination, and access management in Active Directory and Azure AD.
Managed Cisco Meraki and Catalyst networking, firewalls, VPN and PRTG monitoring; reported regularly to the CTO.
Handled internal support tickets, imaged and deployed workstations, and onboarded new hires in Active Directory.
High-volume customer-facing sales and team supervision.

intro_note: Hi, I'm Mat. I build AI automations that act on real systems and I run them in production. My current platform handles calls, CRM updates and follow-ups for 5 local businesses on about 140 n8n workflows. Before that I spent six years keeping a SaaS company's infrastructure up. Your role looks like the work I already do every day, and I'd be glad to talk it through.
